notes: Clip B, 1996-1999: Mega Drive 'latest figure' from Mar 1996; Game Gear 'latest figure' at 31 Mar 1996 only, then Master System and Game Gear 'retired' from 30 Jun 1996 (Telecompaper, 15 Apr 1996); Game Boy takes the crown from the NES at 31 Dec 1997; Saturn 'retired' from Mar 1998 (Sega's final total). Opens on the board of the last quarter end before the window for 2.0 s; final board held 3 s. No music.
